description: This file contains functions for fetching module overview data and metrics from a backend API, including logic for resolving base URLs, making HTTP requests, and deriving fallback modules if primary endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches modules or overview data for the authenticated user/tenant, trying multiple endpoints and deriving fallback modules if primary data is unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total users and deployed applications metrics for the overview screen.
